cards.prose: The son in the far country says *I will arise and go to my father*, and Ezekiel's verse says what such a turning is worth: the wicked man who turns from all his sins and keeps the statutes *shall surely live*. The father says *this my son was dead, and is alive again* (Luke 15:24). Read line on line, the son is the divorced house of Yashar'el (Israel) coming home from the nations; Luke does not name the houses, so this is a reading.
cards.member_phrase: the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes
cards.member_sentence: Ezekiel says the wicked man who turns from all his sins and keeps the statutes shall surely live and not die.
cards.flag: The houses reading is the author's line on line; Luke does not state it, so the prose says so.
